package com.mukasanches.zapptv.model

enum class ChannelSource {
    NATIVE_TUNER,
    NATIVE_TV_APP,
    HLS,
    IPTV,
    WEB
}

data class Channel(
    val id: String,
    val number: String,
    val name: String,
    val source: ChannelSource,
    val canonicalId: String? = null,
    val category: String = "TV",
    val uri: String? = null,
    val nativeInputId: String? = null,
    val nativeChannelId: Long? = null,
    val packageName: String? = null,
    val epgId: String? = null,
    val logoUri: String? = null,
    val sourceName: String = "",
    val sourceNames: List<String> = emptyList(),
    val backupUris: List<String> = emptyList()
) {
    fun playbackUris(): List<String> =
        (listOfNotNull(uri) + backupUris)
            .map { it.trim() }
            .filter { it.startsWith("http://", true) || it.startsWith("https://", true) }
            .distinct()

    fun sourceCount(): Int =
        sourceNames.filter { it.isNotBlank() }.distinct().size.coerceAtLeast(1)
}

class IptvPlaylistParserTest {
    @Test
    fun parsesBrazilianM3uMetadataAndGuide() {
        val m3u = """
            #EXTM3U x-tvg-url="https://example.test/guide.xml"
            #EXTINF:-1 tvg-id="TVBrasil.br" tvg-logo="https://example.test/logo.png" group-title="General",TV Brasil (720p)
            https://example.test/live.m3u8
        """.trimIndent()

        val parsed = m3u.byteInputStream().bufferedReader().use(IptvPlaylistParser::parse)

        assertEquals(listOf("https://example.test/guide.xml"), parsed.epgUrls)
        assertEquals(1, parsed.channels.size)
        val channel = parsed.channels.single()
        assertEquals("TV Brasil", channel.name)
        assertEquals("TVBrasil.br", channel.epgId)
        assertEquals("General", channel.category)
        assertEquals(ChannelSource.IPTV, channel.source)
        assertTrue(channel.number.toInt() >= 1000)
    }
}

class XmlTvParserTest {
    @Test
    fun mapsCurrentProgrammeByTvgId() {
        val now = 1_700_000_000_000L
        val format = SimpleDateFormat("yyyyMMddHHmmss Z", Locale.US).apply {
            timeZone = TimeZone.getTimeZone("UTC")
        }
        val start = format.format(Date(now - 30 * 60 * 1000L))
        val stop = format.format(Date(now + 30 * 60 * 1000L))
        val nextStart = format.format(Date(now + 30 * 60 * 1000L))
        val nextStop = format.format(Date(now + 90 * 60 * 1000L))
        val xml = """
            <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
            <tv>
              <programme start="$start" stop="$stop" channel="TVBrasil.br">
                <title>Jornal Teste</title>
                <sub-title>Edição nacional</sub-title>
                <desc>Notícias do dia</desc>
              </programme>
              <programme start="$nextStart" stop="$nextStop" channel="TVBrasil.br">
                <title>Programa Seguinte</title>
              </programme>
            </tv>
        """.trimIndent()

        val file = File.createTempFile("zapptv-epg", ".xml")
        try {
            file.writeText(xml)
            val channel = Channel(
                id = "iptv:TVBrasil.br",
                number = "1000",
                name = "TV Brasil",
                source = ChannelSource.IPTV,
                epgId = "TVBrasil.br"
            )

            val programs = XmlTvParser.parseCurrentPrograms(file, listOf(channel), now)
            val program = programs[channel.id]
            assertNotNull(program)
            assertEquals("Jornal Teste", program?.title)
            assertEquals("Edição nacional", program?.subtitle)
            assertEquals("Notícias do dia", program?.description)
            assertEquals("Programa Seguinte", program?.nextTitle)
            assertEquals(now + 30 * 60 * 1000L, program?.nextStartMillis)
        } finally {
            file.delete()
        }
    }

    @Test
    fun keepsFutureTimelineForGridGuide() {
        val now = 1_750_000_000_000L
        val format = java.text.SimpleDateFormat("yyyyMMddHHmmss Z", java.util.Locale.US).apply {
            timeZone = java.util.TimeZone.getTimeZone("UTC")
        }
        val currentStart = format.format(java.util.Date(now - 10 * 60 * 1000L))
        val currentStop = format.format(java.util.Date(now + 20 * 60 * 1000L))
        val nextStart = format.format(java.util.Date(now + 20 * 60 * 1000L))
        val nextStop = format.format(java.util.Date(now + 80 * 60 * 1000L))
        val laterStart = format.format(java.util.Date(now + 80 * 60 * 1000L))
        val laterStop = format.format(java.util.Date(now + 140 * 60 * 1000L))
        val xml = """
            <tv>
              <programme start="$currentStart" stop="$currentStop" channel="TVBrasil.br"><title>Agora</title></programme>
              <programme start="$nextStart" stop="$nextStop" channel="TVBrasil.br"><title>Depois</title></programme>
              <programme start="$laterStart" stop="$laterStop" channel="TVBrasil.br"><title>Mais tarde</title></programme>
            </tv>
        """.trimIndent()

        val file = kotlin.io.path.createTempFile(suffix = ".xml").toFile()
        try {
            file.writeText(xml)
            val channel = com.mukasanches.zapptv.model.Channel(
                id = "tv-brasil",
                number = "1",
                name = "TV Brasil",
                source = com.mukasanches.zapptv.model.ChannelSource.IPTV,
                epgId = "TVBrasil.br"
            )

            val schedule = XmlTvParser.parseSchedule(file, listOf(channel), now)

            org.junit.Assert.assertEquals("Agora", schedule.currentPrograms["tv-brasil"]?.title)
            org.junit.Assert.assertEquals(
                listOf("Agora", "Depois", "Mais tarde"),
                schedule.timeline["tv-brasil"]?.map { it.title }
            )
        } finally {
            file.delete()
        }
    }
}

/**
 * Builds the same user-facing media concepts behind mature TV clients without
 * coupling ZappTV to any third-party private backend.
 *
 * This layer is deliberately additive: existing repositories remain the source
 * of truth and can opt into these projections incrementally.
 */
data class MediaLibrary(
    val live: List<Channel>,
    val favorites: List<Channel>,
    val recent: List<Channel>,
    val categories: Map<String, List<Channel>>
)

object MediaLibraryBuilder {
    fun build(
        channels: List<Channel>,
        favoriteIds: Set<String>,
        recentIds: List<String>
    ): MediaLibrary {
        val unique = channels.distinctBy(Channel::id)
        val byId = unique.associateBy(Channel::id)

        val favorites = favoriteIds.mapNotNull(byId::get)
        val recent = recentIds.mapNotNull(byId::get)

        val categories = unique
            .groupBy { it.category.trim().ifBlank { "TV" } }
            .toSortedMap(String.CASE_INSENSITIVE_ORDER)

        return MediaLibrary(
            live = unique,
            favorites = favorites,
            recent = recent,
            categories = categories
        )
    }

    fun search(channels: List<Channel>, query: String): List<Channel> {
        val normalized = query.trim()
        if (normalized.isBlank()) return channels

        return channels.filter { channel ->
            channel.name.contains(normalized, ignoreCase = true) ||
                channel.number.contains(normalized, ignoreCase = true) ||
                channel.category.contains(normalized, ignoreCase = true) ||
                channel.sourceName.contains(normalized, ignoreCase = true)
        }
    }
}

class HomeChannelRankerTest {

    fun favoritesAndRecentChannelsRiseWithoutRemovingOthers() {
        val a = Channel("a", "1", "Alpha", ChannelSource.IPTV)
        val b = Channel("b", "2", "Beta", ChannelSource.IPTV)
        val c = Channel("c", "3", "Cinema", ChannelSource.IPTV)
        val programs = mapOf("c" to ProgramInfo("c", "Filme"))

        val ranked = HomeChannelRanker.rank(
            channels = listOf(a, b, c),
            favorites = setOf("b"),
            recentIds = listOf("a"),
            mostWatchedIds = emptyList(),
            programs = programs
        )

        assertEquals(listOf("b", "a", "c"), ranked.map { it.id })
    }
}
